narration: You're walking out of the grocery store spending twenty-one hundred dollars more than you should every single year. Not because you're buying extra — because of what's printed on the box.
visual: Shopping cart SVG spring-animating in from center, large $2,100 counter rolling up in green, 'WASTED ON BRAND NAMES' text appearing beneath, subtle tagline fading in

narration: Here's what brands don't want you knowing: roughly eighty percent of store-brand products come from the exact same factories as the name brands. Same recipe, same machinery, different label.
visual: Factory building SVG with smoke chimneys, arrow revealing two product boxes — 'BRAND NAME $10' in gray and 'STORE BRAND $6.50' in green, '~80% SAME MANUFACTURER' text appearing

narration: The average price gap is thirty to forty percent. That's three fifty on a ten dollar box of cereal — and you're making that choice dozens of times every single grocery run.
visual: Two bars growing up from bottom: gray bar for $10 brand name, green bar for $6.50 store brand, '35% CHEAPER — SAME PRODUCT' callout text fading in below

narration: So why do we still reach for the name brand? It's called the halo effect — and food companies spend thirteen billion dollars a year on advertising to wire that loyalty into your brain.
visual: Brain outline SVG springing in, large '$13B' counter counting up, 'SPENT ON ADS PER YEAR' subtitle, 'BUYING YOUR LOYALTY' text in green fading in

narration: If you invested that twenty-one hundred dollars every year at eight percent market returns, after thirty years you'd have two hundred and thirty-seven thousand dollars. From one grocery store habit.
visual: Four growing bars: Yr 1 $2,100, Yr 10 $31K, Yr 20 $104K, Yr 30 $237K highlighted in green, '$237,000 FROM ONE SWAP' text appearing at bottom

narration: Start with the easy swaps — canned goods, pasta, cleaning supplies, frozen veggies, cereal. You won't taste the difference, but your bank account will. Follow for more money tricks like this.
visual: Checklist of five items appearing one by one with green checkmark boxes, piggy bank SVG appearing at bottom filling with coins, 'SAVE $2,100 THIS YEAR' and follow CTA
